entries.subject: Erriapus lightcurve-constrained display ellipsoid
entries.finding: The delivery uses the published 1.51:1 minimum equatorial ratio and 5.1 km reference radius as an equal-short-axis display ellipsoid. The source defines a lower-limit photometric constraint, not a recovered surface.

entries.subject: Erriapus Cassini ISS photometry
entries.finding: Cassini ISS and the Erriapus observation record supply the disk-integrated brightness and elongation evidence used by the bounded shape model. They are not a registered photographic surface or spatial colour lens.

entries.subject: Potential native Erriapus convex inversion mesh
entries.finding: The reviewed 2026 report describes calculated Saturnian models and papers in preparation, but did not provide a downloadable Erriapus mesh. The authored approximation is retained without claiming that a native mesh is absent.
entries.revisitWhen: A released Erriapus mesh with a documented body frame, method and reuse route can be compared with this approximation.

entries.subject: Erriapus registered imagery, terrain and composition routes
entries.finding: The reviewed Cassini and author sources qualify no registered image map, DEM, geology layer or spatial composition product for Erriapus. Integrated observations remain separate from the explicit missing-data grid.
entries.revisitWhen: A body-specific registered image, terrain, geology or spatial-composition release can support a separately qualified lens.
